findings.message: Implies sanskritdocuments lacks samapravṛttikaḥ … bhajāmy aham; both its pages print it as main text and give the other pāda only as a bracketed variant.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Both sanskritdocuments.org pages, while reading samapravṛttikaḥ … bhajāmy aham in the main text, give a variant last pāda in brackets…'
